BiblicalUsage: A boil is plague made visible. Ashes sprinkled toward heaven became a boil breaking forth with blains upon man and beast in Egypt, Job was smitten with sore boils from the sole of his foot to his crown, and Hezekiah was healed when Isaiah laid a lump of figs on the boil. Leviticus gives the priest the rule for telling a boil from a plague.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe boils preach that the body is not separate from the soul's story. God struck with them, God healed through them, and I hold that He is Lord over the sores as well as the songs.
